title: Headhunter
text:
Headhunter is a third-person stealth/action shooter in the vein of Metal Gear Solid. It was one of the last games to be released for the Dreamcast.

Story

Set in Los Angeles in the near future, Headhunter puts the player in the role of amnesiac ex-bounty hunter Jack Wade, contracted by his boss' daughter to find the man who murdered her father. Tracking the culprit through various gang hideouts and criminal organizations, Jack discovers that his skills haven't entirely deserted him along with his memory, and is soon on the trail of the mastermind behind a conspiracy to take control of the world, as well as rob Jack of his memory and life.
